D: A psychiatrist starts seeing a terrifying smiling presence after a disturbing session with a patient.
P: Serve dessert when Rose finally heads back to her childhood home.
S: the grin she can't stop seeing
Mashed potato mixed with cheddar and a little flour, rolled out, cut into rounds with two eyes and a wide smile pressed in, baked at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp.
her sister's family party in the backyard

Smoky slow-roasted pork shoulder pulled and tossed in barbecue sauce, piled on soft slider buns with crunchy apple slaw and pickles. Rub a 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt. Put in a covered dish with 200ml apple juice and roast at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Shred and toss with 200ml barbecue sauce. Shred a quarter cabbage and 1 green apple into matchsticks and toss with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 12 split slider buns with pork, slaw and pickles.
Crunchy bite-size buttermilk fried chicken pieces with a honey mustard dip. Soak 600g diced chicken thigh in 250ml buttermilk for 1 hour.
M: dinner with her fiancé, before it falls apart
Salmon fillet roasted skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes, with lemon and dill butter, crushed potatoes and green beans.
Late-shift miso ramen with soft eggs
the long nights she can't sleep

Rich miso and chicken broth over springy ramen noodles with seared pork belly, jammy soy eggs, corn, spring onion and a drizzle of chilli oil. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and soak in 100ml soy, 100ml water and 1 tbsp sugar for 2 hours. Slice 500g pork belly and pan fry until crisp. Heat 1.6 litres chicken stock with 2 grated garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger, then whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy off the boil. Cook 4 serves ramen noodles. Divide noodles and broth into bowls and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, spring onion and chilli oil.
W: Vanilla sugar cookies cut into rounds, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced pale yellow with a wide red smile piped on. A little unsettling.
K: Chamomile steeped strong, stirred with honey, lemon and a nip of whisky, served hot in mugs with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with cloves. Steep 4 chamomile tea bags in 800ml just-boiled water for 5 minutes, then remove. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and the juice of a lemon. Add 30ml whisky to each of 4 mugs, pour over the tea and finish with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with 3 cloves. Leave out the whisky for a plain version.

s.note: the grin she can't stop seeing
s.how: Mash 600g boiled potatoes with 80g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp flour and 20g butter. Roll out 1cm thick and cut rounds. Press in two eyes and a wide smile with a straw and spoon. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes until crisp.

Soak 600g diced chicken thigh in 250ml buttermilk for 1 hour. Toss in 150g flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with 4 tbsp honey mixed with 3 tbsp Dijon.

m.note: dinner with her fiancé, before it falls apart
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and dill and spoon over. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 300g green beans.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Cut rounds and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Ice pale yellow with 300g icing sugar and pipe a wide red smile on each. A little unsettling.

Add 30ml whisky to each of 4 mugs, pour over the tea and finish with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with 3 cloves. Leave out the whisky for a plain version.
